name: 灵框 LingKuang v3 — 阈限梦核
description: AI-driven plugin toolbox (Electron + React) dressed as a half-remembered dream. Warm-washed liminal lobby, fluorescent-tube green living accent, recessed 'niche-in-the-wall' depth, VHS grain, and breath-like motion. Built for an 18-year-old art student steeped in Threshold Spaces, Dreamcore, and Backrooms aesthetics.
